pcb_glhud_shot tb_doors_mc_0
ent_fire tb_go_doors trigger
wait 600
pcb_face tb_door
wait 4
pcb_glhud_shot tb_doors_mc_1
ent_fire tb_reset_doors trigger
wait 600
pcb_log TB gel mc: gel falls from the ceiling at u=0 v=256 (8 blobs/s, 60 u/s) and coats the floor
pcb_goto tb_spot_gel 64
waituntil mcleads 1200
wait 40
pcb_face tb_gel
wait 4
pcb_glhud_shot tb_gel_mc_0
ent_fire tb_go_gel trigger
wait 800
pcb_face tb_gel
wait 4
pcb_glhud_shot tb_gel_mc_1
ent_fire tb_reset_gel trigger
wait 800
pcb_movers write
pcb_log TB done
pcb_run_summary
quit
